annotations.title: Gather sourced machine-readable evidence supporting or contradicting a prediction market proposition

description: Returns current, sourced and machine-readable evidence supporting or contradicting a prediction-market proposition. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.05 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

context.description: Optional contextual metadata (e.g. { ticker: 'KXFEDDECISION-26DEC', compareVenues: true }).

market.description: Market venue identifier ('polymarket', 'kalshi', 'cross-venue', 'omen'). Auto-detects 'kalshi' from kalshi.com URLs or KX* tickers; defaults to 'polymarket'.

marketUrl.description: Optional Polymarket or Kalshi market URL for live rules and snapshot extraction.

question.description: Prediction market question or proposition (Polymarket, Kalshi, or cross-venue). Includes 1 free daily check per IP.
